name: bld6_succ_pow_lt_exp_pow_mul_factorial
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n < Real.exp 1 ^ n * n.factorial
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n), ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ n < Real.exp 1 ^ n * n.factorial
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_one_add_inv_pow_lt_exp: induction on n via (n+1)^n/n! = ∏_{k=1}^n (1+1/k)^k (ratio of consecutive terms is (1+1/(n+1))^(n+1)); each factor is < e by calc_one_add_inv_pow_lt_exp. Strengthens Mathlib2.calc_factorial_gt_div_exp_pow from n^n to (n+1)^n.
